customManagers.description: The gekko CLI version the setup-gekko-cli-action installs, so it is bumped together with the in-app agent (the Gradle plugin version in libs.versions.toml).

packageRules.description: The gekko CLI and the in-app agent talk to each other, so their versions move in one PR.

AGP 9.3.x+ outruns what the locally installed Android Studio supports — sync fails with unsupported-AGP-version and "could not find compile target" errors. Hold AGP updates until Studio's bundled support catches up.
Gradle 9.7+ doesn't work with the current IntelliJ, so the wrapper is pinned to 9.6.x. Still allows 9.6 patch releases; lift this once IntelliJ supports 9.7.
